title: Tesla and SpaceX Explore Merger as Elon Musk Backs Deal
hook_text: Elon Musk Backs Tesla SpaceX Merger
script:
Elon Musk is backing a potential merger between Tesla and SpaceX.
Tesla contributes electric vehicle manufacturing and Full Self Driving autonomous systems to the discussions.
SpaceX brings aerospace engineering, Falcon rocket launches, and the Starlink satellite internet network.
The combined enterprise would unite heavy manufacturing with deep space infrastructure.
Financial markets are evaluating how corporate valuations will adjust for both entities.
Would you buy shares in a combined Tesla and SpaceX?
